instrument.variant: general checkpoint without the Charades-STA/ActivityNet-subset third-stage tuning
instrument.resolution_rule: Before any download, record one exact repository revision and SHA-256 for every required weight and code artifact. Abort if the general and benchmark-subset-tuned variants cannot be unambiguously separated.

resource_boundary.preferred_runtime: Authors' CUDA/BF16 path on one NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM
resource_boundary.apple_silicon: M5 32 GB is memory-feasible in principle but requires a separately validated public-only port; no restricted run may be the first Mac compatibility test.
resource_boundary.maximum_model_download: Only the exact pinned 4B checkpoint and required code after explicit execution authorization; no dataset or model archive.

stage_0_public_canary.data: Eight newly generated public synthetic clips with oracle German object/action queries, balanced across lead, overlap, lag, null, and ambiguous cases.
stage_0_public_canary.same_input_representation_as_restricted_: Five ordered frames at -5, -2.5, 0, +2.5, and +5 seconds plus one German query.
stage_0_public_canary.prompt_tuning: One frozen prompt written before model output is viewed.
stage_0_public_canary.pass: At least 7 of 8 exact-schema outputs and at least 6 of 8 oracle referential-plus-lag decisions correct.
stage_0_public_canary.failure: Stop before quarantine discovery. Do not translate, tune, retry, substitute a model, or run restricted inference.

stage_1_restricted_one_shot.condition: Only after the public canary passes and the exact runtime is hash-pinned.
stage_1_restricted_one_shot.sample: Reuse the same 27 prediction-blind windows frozen in qwen_accuracy_audit_v1; no reselection.
stage_1_restricted_one_shot.inputs: The same existing five-frame representation and the same existing local ASR hypothesis used by Qwen3-VL.

human_review.reviewer: Qualified German interpreter, blinded to instrument identity and Qwen output
human_review.if_unavailable: Report only schema/runtime feasibility and abstention; make no lexical or accuracy claim.

predeclared_metrics.qwen_comparison: Paired descriptive counts only; no majority vote and no agreement-as-truth claim.

screening_decision.promising_second_instrument: At least 19 of 27 complete answers defensible, Wilson 95% lower bound at least 0.50, schema validity at least 0.90, and abstention at most 0.50.
screening_decision.otherwise: Do not use the model to reopen the ChildLens calibration branch.
